description: This file defines UI components and utility functions for the Summernote rich text editor, including creation of editor elements, dialogs, dropdowns, color palettes, and event handling.

classes.name: ui
classes.description: An object containing references to UI components and utility functions for Summernote.

methods.name: createLayout
methods.description: Creates and inserts the Summernote editor layout into the DOM.

methods.name: removeLayout
methods.description: Removes the Summernote editor layout from the DOM and restores the original element.
